blocks.text: Match preview: Western Australia face South Australia in 1st Match (ODI) on Fri, 18 Sept, 2026, 11:30 am at W.A.C.A. Ground Perth. Full pitch report, weather forecast, and squad details below.
Pace and bounce typical of Australian wickets; good carry for fast bowlers.
Rain showers · High 26°C / Low 14°C · Rain: 7 mm · Wind: up to 18 km/h. Rain likely — DLS may apply; favour bowlers who hit the deck and teams with depth.
International playing XI is announced at the toss. Check back on match day for confirmed line-ups.
